items.reason: Chewbacca's Action 'Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted' can pick a friendly Force unit, and The Holy City's 'When a friendly Force unit attacks: The Force is with you' then fires on that extra attack.

Shadow Cloaking's 'Ready a unit' can ready an exhausted Khetanna, who has an On Attack ability ('When Played/On Attack: The next Underworld unit you play this phase costs 1 resource less'), so she can swing again and re-fire On Attack. The wants tag for ready-unit is absent on Khetanna, but the extra-attacks side of the row still holds.

Ritual Dragon's text 'While you control a Tatooine base, friendly units enter play ready' makes units enter ready; it does not ready an exhausted unit or give an extra attack. Ezra Bridger's 'When a friendly unit's attack ends' trigger is not fed by entering play ready, and the Tatooine base condition is not shown as met.

Theed Security's text 'If an opponent controls an upgrade, give an Experience token to a unit' needs an upgrade controlled by the opponent. Wingman Victor Two's Piloting upgrade is played on a friendly Vehicle, so the same player controls it, which fails the same-side requirement.

Battered Haulcraft's 'Deal 1 damage to this unit and 1 damage to an enemy space unit' damages only itself, not Sandtrooper Cavalry. Sandtrooper Cavalry's Grit ('gets +1/+0 for each damage on it') needs damage on itself, so the Haulcraft's self-damage does not feed it.
Darth Maul's Lightsaber is 'Attach to a friendly non-Vehicle unit', and Axe Woves is a Trooper (not a Vehicle), so the upgrade can attach to him. Axe Woves 'gets +1/+1 for each upgrade on him'.

Howl's 'You may return a non-leader unit to its owner's hand' can return your own Teeka, whose When Played ('Choose one: Give a unit Sentinel...') can then be replayed. Teeka also wants replay-when-played, so the claim holds.
Dooku's 'When Played: You may ready another unit' can ready an exhausted Executor, whose 'When Played/On Attack/When Defeated: Create 3 TIE Fighter tokens' fires again on the second attack.

Chewbacca's 'Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted' can attack with Halo, and Halo's 'When Attack Ends: If the defending unit was defeated, give a Shield token to this unit' fires again on the extra attack.
Force Speed's 'Attack with a unit' can pick Captain Rex, and Rex's 'When this unit completes an attack: Give this unit and an enemy unit Sentinel for this phase' fires on the extra attack.

R2-D2's Piloting upgrade is playable only 'on a friendly Vehicle unit with a Pilot on it', and Axe Woves is a Trooper with no Vehicle trait. R2-D2 therefore cannot attach to Axe Woves, so the upgrade-stacking offer is not available for him.
Sith Holocron says 'Attach to a Force unit', and Qui-Gon Jinn (The Negotiations Will Be Short) has the printed Force trait. The trait reference is satisfied.

Darth Maul's Lightsaber says 'If attached unit is Darth Maul, you may attack with him'. The extra attack is restricted to Darth Maul, so it cannot fire C-3PO's 'On Attack' ability, which needs C-3PO to attack.

Luminara Unduli's 'When you play a unit (including this one): You may attack with a unit' can choose Qui-Gon Jinn (Influencing Chance), whose 'When Played/On Attack: Look at the top 3 cards' then fires on the attack.
Hotshot Maneuver says 'Then, attack with the chosen unit', and the chosen friendly unit can be Lieutenant Gorn, whose 'On Attack: Take control of an enemy Credit token' then fires.
Special Modifications is 'Attach to a Vehicle unit' and cannot attach to a base. Queen Amidala's cost reduction needs 'an upgraded base', which this upgrade cannot create.

Backed by the Hutts 'may deal damage to a unit equal to the number of friendly Credit tokens' can target a friendly unit for at least 1 damage after creating a Credit token. Heroic ARC-170's 'If you control a damaged unit, you may deal 2 damage to an enemy unit' then has a damaged unit to check.

Saw Gerrera's U-Wing 'When this unit completes an attack (and survives): You may attack with another Aggression unit' can attack with Poggle the Lesser, an Aggression unit, whose deployBox 'On Attack: You may ready a friendly Creature unit' then fires.

Trust Your Instincts 'If you do, attack with a unit' can attack with a friendly unit, and Shin Hati's 'When a friendly unit's attack ends' then fires. The leader's 'Use this ability only once each round' limits the benefit but does not negate it.

Luke Skywalker's 'When Played: An opponent chooses one ... You may deal 5 damage to a unit' can damage a friendly unit if the opponent picks that mode, and Power from Pain's 'Give a unit +1/+0 for this phase for each damage on it' then pays off. The benefit depends on the opponent's choice, but the link is real.
Echo Base Engineer's 'You may give a Shield token to a damaged Vehicle unit' references the Vehicle trait, and Screeching TIE Fighter has the printed Vehicle trait.

Galvanized Leap 'Ready a unit that was damaged this phase' can ready Migs Mayfeld after he attacks and takes damage, and Migs's 'On Attack: Deal 1 damage to the defending unit' then fires on the second attack. The 'damaged this phase' condition limits when this works.

Lost and Forgotten's 'Defeat a non-leader unit' can defeat your own Tireless Magnaguard (power 5). Its 'When Defeated: If this unit had 5 or more power, for this phase you may play this unit from your discard pile for free' then fires.
LEP Ratcatcher's 'When Played: You may deal 1 damage to a ground unit' can target your own Ground unit, Qui-Gon Jinn (We'll Handle This), whose Grit gives him '+1/+0 for each damage on it'.

Log Trap's 'Attack with a friendly unit. Then attack with it again' can attack with a unit that Paige Tico is attached to, and the attached unit gains 'On Attack: Give an Experience token to this unit, then deal 1 damage to it.'
